Bellarminus igitur, ut altero Origenis & Theodoreti errato fucum faciat, alterum emendat: & eorum sententiam, mutatis Cynocephalorum similiumque rerum exemplis in exepla hominum, ita recitat, ut afferre videantur quod pernegant. page.notes: The marginal notes are abbreviated references in small type and some are hard to read: the Greek mark near "Ἀναχ." and the note after "in Ba-" and the note "Paufan. Arcadicis" are doubtful. The note "Apud Mie-dolan." is partly illegible. Reference marks in the text (a–q) are only partly legible; the letters are read from the matching notes. The text at the place "iuo:qui" and "in exepla" appears to be printed as shown. The line "ut quum Gentiles proponebat sta-" ends with a line-end hyphen, not a catchword.
